formulas.ascii: q = round(z/Q) with Q = quantum (default 1/256); the annulus A holds cells with Chebyshev distance in (innerRadius, radius] from the centre, clipped to the raster and to valid cells (N of them); innerRadius 0 excludes only the centre. TPI = z_c - mean(z over A) = -Q * sum_A (q_a - q_c) / N, with the sum taken exactly modulo 2^64 from the summed-area table. NaN where the centre is invalid or N = 0. One output plane per scale.
y[i] = sum(x[s(i)..i-1+delta]) mod 2^32; delta=0 exclusive (default), 1 inclusive; s(i) is the last nonzero segment flag or 0.
